events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect sender check script usage and sender list
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs | grep -n -i -E "usage|argv|env" | head; grep -rln "dossier.md" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-418.json 2>/dev/null; grep -o '"[a-z]*@[a-z]*\(advisorywebinars\|bankintrosummit\|capitalwebinars\|startupwebinars\|advisorymasterclass\)\.com"' -r workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-418.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -30

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; f=$(git ls-files | grep -i 'dossier.md' | head -5); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do grep -o -E '[a-z.]+@(advisorymasterclass|advisorywebinars|bankintrosummit|capitalwebinars|startupwebinars)\.com' "$x"; done | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
